player_fantasy: Launch a compact amethyst resonance pulse that pushes threats away.
primary_use_case: Controller-friendly mid-range single-target damage and bounded knockback.
explicit_non_goals: No area damage, stun, homing, splitting, block breaking, custom GUI, or permanent projectile state
No dependency on another Forest Wave feature
dependencies: Minecraft Bedrock behavior and resource packs
future_extension_interfaces: Additional original ammunition may use a distinct item and projectile identifier
Visual variants may replace textures without changing the gameplay contract

gameplay.obtain: Craft from string, sticks, and an amethyst shard; internal test function also grants the kit.
gameplay.ammunition: Resonance Pebble; one consumed per valid activation.
gameplay.activation: Tap use. Stable itemUse is used because a portable stable hold-release event is not present in the pinned API catalog.
gameplay.controller_contract: Single use-button press with owner-only action-bar feedback.

entity_impact.single_processing_path: Script projectileHitEntity; projectile is removed immediately after processing.

gameplay.block_impact: Remove projectile and emit a bounded impact particle.
gameplay.empty_ammunition: No cooldown or durability cost; owner receives an action-bar message.
gameplay.cleanup: Impact removal or entity timer expiry at 60 ticks; no global per-tick scan and no persistent projectile records.

multiplayer.damage_attribution: Entity.applyDamage with damagingEntity set to the owner
multiplayer.knockback_attribution: Impulse computed from projectile travel direction
multiplayer.friendly_fire: Follows ordinary Bedrock damage rules; no custom team bypass.
multiplayer.disconnect: Projectile remains bounded by its entity timer; an invalid owner prevents scripted damage and the projectile is removed.
multiplayer.dimension_change: Projectile remains in its spawn dimension and expires normally.
multiplayer.death: Same as disconnect; no projectile state is restored.
multiplayer.duplicate_prevention: One event path plus immediate projectile removal and an in-memory processed-ID set.
multiplayer.simultaneous_use: Cooldown, inventory, durability, and live-projectile counts are owner-scoped.

persistence.restart_contract: No projectile or script record is restored or duplicated after restart.

originality.sound_direction: Temporary use of a built-in Bedrock sound; no third-party sound file is shipped.
